name: Dialog
description:
A modal panel for a focused task or decision, with optional header and footer content.
Use the trigger slot to open it and provide a clear heading and dismissal action.

props.name: ariaLabelledBy
props.description:
Aria Labelled By attribute
- Dynamically set for A11y

props.name: dialogTrigger
props.description:
The modal trigger if it not slotted in the 'trigger' slot
- Must be set by the trigger's click callback when it calls the modal's open method

props.name: disableClickOutside
props.description:
Disable click outside
- **true** Disables closing the dialog on click outside of the dialog container
- **false** Enables closing the dialog on click outside of the dialog container

props.name: heading
props.description: Heading text that appears in the header region

props.name: isActive
props.description:
Is active?
- **true** Shows the dialog container
- **false** Hides the dialog container

props.name: transitionDelay
props.description:
Number of ms of the dialog's open/close css transition delay
- Used to delay focus trap activation

props.name: width
props.description:
The width of the dialog container
- If no value is entered, it defaults to 432px

events.name: onDialogClose
events.description: Fired when the dialog closes by any means, including backdrop click and Escape. Detail: `{ active, item }`.

events.name: onDialogCloseButton
events.description: Fired only when the dialog's close button is activated. Detail: `{ active, item }`. Use `onDialogClose` to catch every close path.

events.name: onDialogOpen
events.description: Fired when the dialog opens. Detail: `{ active, item }` — the new open state and the dialog element itself.

slots.description: The main body of the dialog

slots.name: footer
slots.description: The footer of the dialog that appears below the main slot

slots.name: header
slots.description: The header of the dialog that appears above the main slot

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: The trigger that opens/closes the dialog

keyboard.action: Opens the dialog from the trigger. Skipped when the trigger contains its own focusable element, which would otherwise double-fire.
Opens the dialog from the trigger. Same trigger-focusable exception as Enter.
Closes the dialog. Only while it is open.
